project: Split Oversized ACP Stdio Tests into Focused Behavioral Suites
description: Mechanically split the oversized ACP stdio prompt and streaming test suites into focused behavioral files with one shared fixture file, preserving the exact test inventory, assertions, runtime outcomes, and coverage so the queued BTRC P5B cutover can work against a readable package.

context.customerAsk: Land a move-only split of the 3,518-line session_prompt_test.go and 1,667-line prompt_stream_test.go before BTRC P5B releases, deriving cohesive behavior groups from the real tests, consolidating shared fixtures into one helper file, and rebasing under the contention protocol if ACP stdio ownership changes.
context.problem: Prompt admission, dispatch, terminal-state, cancellation, attachment, delivery, stream-gap, retry, and live-drain scenarios are mixed in two oversized files, causing unnecessary context burn, slow comprehension, and error-prone edits for ACP transport maintainers.
context.solution: Move existing tests without semantic changes into package-local suites organized around prompt command/admission, prompt dispatch/terminal lifecycle, cancellation/connection failures, stream attachment/delivery, and stream gap/error/live-drain behavior; share cross-suite fixtures through one test-helper file and prove equivalence with before/after inventory, coverage, and focused package-test evidence.

acceptanceCriteria: Normalized output from go test ./pkg/transports/acp/internal/stdio -list '.*' is identical before and after the split, with the zero diff shown in the PR.

Existing prompt, dispatch, terminal-state, cancellation, attachment, stream-delivery, gap, retry, and live-drain tests retain their names, setup semantics, assertions, and observable outcomes, and focused package tests pass.
Before/after ACP stdio package coverage numbers are recorded in the PR and are unchanged using the same command and baseline revision.
Tests are grouped by cohesive behavior, fixtures shared across groups live in one test-helper file, no resulting Go test file exceeds approximately 1,200 lines, and the diff is dominated by moves.
No production code, public contract, generated artifact, assertion semantics, test inventory, or unrelated cleanup changes are included.
Typecheck and tests pass; no NEW lint violations relative to current main, and the gates green on main (backend-size, pkg-maint, pkg-file-count, pkg-structure, vet) stay green.

The implementation/review loop continues until required CI is terminal and passing, all blocking PR conversation feedback is explicitly addressed, merge conflicts are resolved against current main, and the PR is merged.

Moved tests retain their existing setup and assertions, and setup shared by more than one behavioral suite is consolidated into the single package test-helper file without changing fixture behavior.
The partial split is move-dominated and does not change ACP production code or public contracts.
Focused ACP stdio package tests pass.
Tests pass

Consolidated the package-shared ACP stdio fakes and fixtures in session_test_helpers_test.go, including helpers previously defined in session_prompt_test.go, session_new_test.go, session_set_config_option_test.go, and prompt_stream_test.go.
